description: The Maharashtra Cabinet has approved a new Department of Electronics, IT and Artificial Intelligence to strengthen digital governance. The move includes creating over 800 posts, a dedicated IT cadre, and an e-Mission team. Officials said it will enhance service delivery, cybersecurity, and data-driven decision-making across sectors.
body_lead: Mumbai: In a major push towards digital governance and technological advancement, the Maharashtra Cabinet on Tuesday approved the creation of a dedicated Department of Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence. The decision was taken at a Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis. Viksit Maharashtra 2047 Vision The move is aimed at accelerating the state’s “Viksit Maharashtra 2047” vision by strengthening policy-making, implementation and monitoring of technology-driven governance initiatives.
